_comment: Files that must match line for line between crest (src/lib/crest) and damit (damit_crest/src/lib/crest), and the only line pairs allowed to differ. Keep this file identical in both repos. Checked by scripts/check-engine-sync.mjs.

allow.why: crest ships the ND-only VERTCON grid (vertcon_nd.ts); DamIT ships the national one (vertcon.ts).

allow.crest: reasons.push("This is a desk screen on a schematic valley. It is not an ND Dam Safety classification of record.");
allow.damit: reasons.push("This is a desk screen on a schematic valley. It is not an official hazard classification of record.");
allow.why: Disclaimer wording: crest is an ND Dam Safety tool, DamIT is jurisdiction-neutral.
